## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm validate` passes locally (or CI is green)
- [ ] Every work is public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA, and `source_url` shows that licence
- [ ] CC BY / CC BY-SA works have an `attribution` line
- [ ] AI-generated works have `"ai_generated": true`
- [ ] Prefer landscape works with at least 3840 px on the long edge; warnings below that are explained here
